About me

Customer support taught me to listen closely and follow the evidence. That?s the approach I bring to testing software and working with data.

At VelocityEHS, I worked with enterprise customers to reproduce issues across environmental, health, safety, and sustainability applications. I documented what I found and worked with the teams responsible for resolving the issues.

At eSafe Ethiopia, I wrote and ran structured tests for Jegna Cyber Labs? endpoint detection and response platform. I checked how alerts moved through triage and incident response, and verified how the workflows behaved after changes.

In my analytics portfolio, I use that same approach to explore questions about seasonal demand, customer retention, and service operations. I?m interested in making the analysis clear enough that someone can use it to decide what to do next.
